title: I let Opus do a trailer for my educational game
author: Jeckyll25
selftext:
I'm still working on it but I wanted to showcase it since I've posted some images of it and people seemed to like it.

The idea is that you have to solve English grammar tasks which unlocks new skills for your Grammons (= Grammar Monsters). The battles remain completely detached from the educational aspect and you can level your Grammons as well. My goal is to make this a server based game like Tem Tem so students can actually see each other and also fight each other.

Each player can create a team with 3 Grammons. They have different elements and different categories and each Grammon can learn the skills of its element as long as its the same categorie of Grammon as well. So you can customize your Grammons and team quite a bit.

Of course there's a battle pass like unluck for cosmetics so characters can look differently but you also progress it by solving grammar tasks.

Still very early in development though!

comments.author: Fit-Fox-3088
comments.body: Schöne Idee, baue gerade etwas mit ähnlicher Hintergrundgeschichte. In Erdkunde unterrichte ich immer Verkehr/Mobilität. Hab nun ein Verkehrssimulationsspiel mit der Karte vom Ort der Schule entworfen und passende Arbeitsblätter dazu. So können sie spielen und auswerten. Vielleicht erhöht es ja die Motivation etwas! :) viel Erfolg. Zieh es durch!
